hand.definition: The terminal part of the arm beyond the wrist with five digits.
hand.exampleUsage: The human hand has an opposable thumb and four fingers.

palm.definition: The inner flat surface of the hand between wrist and finger bases.
palm.exampleUsage: He held the small smooth stone resting on his palm.

back-of-hand.definition: The outer dorsal surface of the hand opposite the palm.
back-of-hand.exampleUsage: A small birthmark was visible on the back of his hand.

wrist.definition: The joint connecting the hand to the forearm.
wrist.exampleUsage: She wore an adjustable watch strapped around her wrist.

knuckle.definition: A joint of a finger, visible prominently when making a fist.
knuckle.exampleUsage: His knuckles showed clearly as he closed his fingers.

finger.definition: One of the terminal movable digits of the human hand.
finger.exampleUsage: Each finger has three phalanges except the two-bone thumb.

thumb.definition: The short, opposable first digit of the human hand.
thumb.exampleUsage: The opposable thumb enables grasping and fine coordination.

index-finger.definition: The first finger beside the thumb; forefinger.
index-finger.exampleUsage: She pointed toward the diagram using her index finger.

middle-finger.definition: The longest central digit of the hand between index and ring fingers.
middle-finger.exampleUsage: The middle finger is typically the longest digit on the hand.

ring-finger.definition: The fourth digit of the hand situated between middle and little finger.
ring-finger.exampleUsage: A plain ring rested on his left ring finger.

little-finger.definition: The smallest outermost fifth digit of the hand; pinky.
little-finger.exampleUsage: The little finger is the outermost digit of the hand.

fingertip.definition: The sensitive rounded fleshy end of a finger.
fingertip.exampleUsage: Nerve endings in the fingertip sense fine texture.

fingerprint.definition: The unique pattern of friction ridges on the skin of a fingertip.
fingerprint.exampleUsage: Each person possesses a unique friction ridge fingerprint.

nail.definition: The protective keratin plate growing on the dorsal tip of a finger or toe.
nail.exampleUsage: A healthy nail protects the sensitive tissue beneath.

cuticle.definition: The thin fold of dead skin bordering the base of a nail.
cuticle.exampleUsage: She pushed back the softened cuticle during nail care.

joint.definition: An anatomical junction where two or more bones connect.
joint.exampleUsage: Cartilage cushions the movable surfaces of a joint.

phalanx.definition: Any one of the small tubular bones forming fingers or toes.
phalanx.exampleUsage: A finger consists of three individual phalanx bones.

webbing.definition: The natural fold of skin between adjacent fingers or toes.
webbing.exampleUsage: Thin webbing connects the base of neighboring fingers.

crease.definition: A natural skin fold line that develops where a joint bends.
crease.exampleUsage: Flexion creases run across the surface of the palm.

lifeline.definition: A curved crease line running around the base of the thumb on the palm.
lifeline.exampleUsage: In palmistry a curved crease is traditionally called a lifeline.

grip.definition: A firm and secure hold taken with the fingers and hand.
grip.exampleUsage: He maintained a firm grip on the briefcase handle.

pinch.definition: To compress or hold an object between the thumb and forefinger.
pinch.exampleUsage: She pinched the folded paper between thumb and index finger.

grasp.definition: To seize and hold an object firmly with the whole hand.
grasp.exampleUsage: He grasped the handrail securely before climbing the stairs.

squeeze.definition: To compress an object firmly from opposite sides with the hand.
squeeze.exampleUsage: She gently squeezed the foam stress ball with her fingers.

clench.definition: To close the hand or teeth tightly with muscular tension.
clench.exampleUsage: He clenched his fist firmly to test his hand strength.

point.definition: To direct attention toward something using an outstretched finger.
point.exampleUsage: She pointed at the chart on the wall to indicate the figure.

snap.definition: To make a sharp click by flicking a finger against the thumb and palm.
snap.exampleUsage: He snapped his fingers to keep rhythm with the tempo.

wave.definition: To move the open hand back and forth in greeting or signaling.
wave.exampleUsage: She waved her hand in friendly greeting across the lobby.

clap.definition: To strike the palms together repeatedly to produce sound or applause.
clap.exampleUsage: The audience clapped warmly at the end of the presentation.

fist.definition: A closed hand with the fingers curled tightly into the palm.
fist.exampleUsage: He rested his closed fist gently against the table.

foot.definition: The terminal anatomical part of the human leg below the ankle.
foot.exampleUsage: The human foot provides support and balance during upright stance.

heel.definition: The back rounded part of the human foot below the ankle.
heel.exampleUsage: Cushioned shoes reduce impact on the heel.

sole.definition: The underside surface of the foot that touches the floor.
sole.exampleUsage: The rubber sole of the sneaker provides grip on wet tile.

arch.definition: The upward curved structure spanning the bottom of the foot.
arch.exampleUsage: Insole supports distribute pressure along the arch of the foot.

instep.definition: The top arched surface of the foot between ankle and toes.
instep.exampleUsage: The boot collar was padded comfortably over the instep.

ankle.definition: The joint connecting the lower leg with the foot.
ankle.exampleUsage: He wrapped an elastic support around his strained ankle.

toe.definition: One of the terminal digits of the foot.
toe.exampleUsage: The foot has five toes that aid in walking stability.

ball.definition: The cushioned fleshy padding on the sole directly behind the toes.
ball.exampleUsage: Dancers pivot on the ball of the foot with control.

bridge.definition: The upper arched bony ridge running across the top of the foot.
bridge.exampleUsage: The strap of the sandal crossed neatly over the bridge of the foot.

toenail.definition: The hard protective keratin plate covering the tip of a toe.
toenail.exampleUsage: Trim the toenail straight across to prevent irritation.

manicure.definition: A professional grooming treatment for the fingernails and hands.
manicure.exampleUsage: She scheduled a manicure to clean and shape her nails.

pedicure.definition: A professional cosmetic and grooming treatment for the feet and toenails.
pedicure.exampleUsage: A relaxing pedicure keeps toenails tidy and moisturized.

nail-polish.definition: A cosmetic lacquer applied to color or protect fingernails and toenails.
nail-polish.exampleUsage: She applied a clear coat of protective nail polish.

nail-file.definition: A fine abrasive tool used to smooth and contour nail edges.
nail-file.exampleUsage: He used an emery nail file to smooth the rough nail tip.

lotion.definition: A smooth liquid cosmetic formula used to soften and hydrate skin.
lotion.exampleUsage: Apply soothing lotion to hydrate dry skin after washing.

moisturizer.definition: A hydrating cream or lotion formulated to restore skin moisture.
moisturizer.exampleUsage: A rich moisturizer protects the hands from dry winter air.

exfoliant.definition: A skin care preparation that removes dead surface epidermal cells.
exfoliant.exampleUsage: A gentle exfoliant smooths rough patches on the heels.

pumice-stone.definition: A lightweight porous volcanic rock used to buff away rough foot skin.
pumice-stone.exampleUsage: She gently rubbed a pumice stone over callused heel skin.

cuticle-oil.definition: A nourishing oil formulated to condition skin surrounding the nails.
cuticle-oil.exampleUsage: Drop a little cuticle oil around each nail to prevent cracking.

hand-cream.definition: A rich moisturizing cream formulated specifically to soften dry hands.
hand-cream.exampleUsage: Keep a tube of hand cream in your desk for daily use.
